recommendation: Reject the frozen BRENTOIL oil-shock continuation mechanism and retain V57 unchanged. Do not open validation or holdout and do not promote either oil-shock direction.
why_now: The preregistered development-only replay completed with exact evidence and continuation lost in every fold, both directions, and both nominal and stress executions.
evidence_reviewed: The preregistration written before continuation results were observed.
The immutable continuation development report and its source/generator identities.
The prior reversion development baseline used only for the no-action comparison.
observed_problem_or_opportunity: Direction inversion did not recover the BRENTOIL shock edge. Continuation produced 11 wins and 34 losses nominally, 9 wins and 37 losses under stress, and all three chronological stress folds lost.
applicable_market_regime: The exact frozen five-minute oil-shock detector over the development window 2026-06-08T08:00:00Z through 2026-07-13T21:45:00Z.
alternatives_considered: Promote continuation because it traded frequently; rejected because frequency accompanied negative expectancy.
Select only the less-negative session or direction; rejected as post-hoc and both sides remained negative.
Retune shock thresholds, target, stop, or hold; rejected because the preregistered one-degree-of-freedom test failed and tuning would reopen selection risk.
Retain the live V57 portfolio unchanged; selected as the no-action baseline.
expected_upside: Avoids allocating live capital to a mechanism with strongly adverse development evidence and prevents repeated research on the same failed directionality assumption.
main_risks_and_failure_modes: Development-only rejection can miss a later regime in which continuation works.
Unresolved mark-path bars mean exact loss magnitudes are not fully qualified, although they cannot convert the uniformly negative economic evidence into a promotion result.
A materially different oil mechanism could still exist; this decision rejects only the frozen continuation specification.
validation_completed: Exact source hashes matched the preregistered BRENTOIL database, audit, qualification, fee, liquidity, funding, and live-friction evidence.
Validation and holdout remained unopened and were not selection inputs.
Nominal, stress, both directions, all three chronological folds, largest-winner sensitivity, liquidation, and technical-path checks were evaluated.
The report carries execution_authority=none, automatic_promotion=false, and live_roster_change=false.
validation_still_required: None for rejection of this exact frozen continuation mechanism.
Any future BRENTOIL proposal must specify a materially different causal mechanism before seeing results and begin with a new preregistration.
failure_or_rollback_triggers: The preregistered failure conditions were met; the experiment is closed and no live rollback is required because no live change occurred.
confidence_level: High confidence that the exact frozen continuation specification should be rejected; medium confidence about the precise loss magnitude because 23 nominal and 20 stress lifecycles overlap unresolved technical paths.
claim_falsifiers: A source or generator audit showing the published report did not use the preregistered identity would invalidate this result.
A new, preregistered, materially different oil mechanism with technically resolved positive stress and ex-largest-winner evidence could update the broader BRENTOIL opportunity assessment.
This rejection does not claim that all possible BRENTOIL strategies are unprofitable.
single_highest_value_next_investigation: Return priority to the exact active V57 routes and the fixed MU transport-parity conclusion; do not spend another trial on oil-shock direction inversion.
